systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous Supercritical Fluid Rapid Expansion into Aqueous Media (RESOLV) Industrial Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Continuous Non-Thermal Supercritical Nano-Liposome Synthesis Skid (FDA 21 CFR § 117 FSMA cGMP / USP <729> Globule Size Distribution in Lipid Emulsions / USP <711> Dissolution / 3-A Sanitary Standards 63-04 & 08-17 / EHEDG Type EL Class I CIP / ASME Section VIII Div 1 & ASME B31.3 High-Pressure Process Piping)
systemArchitectures.technology: Rapid Expansion of Supercritical Solutions into Aqueous Media (RESOLV, P = 180 – 320 bar, T = 38 – 45°C) across sapphire micro-metered expansion nozzles (d_nozzle = 50 – 120 µm, L/D = 8 – 15) directly into an aqueous receiving phase with inline cyclone CO2 gas-liquid separation and closed-loop CO2 re-compression, producing ultra-uniform unilamellar nano-liposomes (d_50 = 50 – 85 nm, PDI < 0.045) with >94.5% entrapment efficiency without high-shear mechanical damage
systemArchitectures.cipSanitizationRating: 100% Resistant to 2.0% NaOH at 80°C, 1.5% PAA at 50°C, Automated Clean-in-Place (CIP) & Supercritical CO2 Sterile Depressurization Conformance

bioactivePayloadFormulations.name: Astaxanthin Carotenoid Unilamellar Nano-Liposomes (Haematococcus pluvialis)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.payloadDescription: Natural all-trans astaxanthin lipophilic antioxidant encapsulated in hydrogenated soy phosphatidylcholine bilayer for protection against photodegradation and oxidative bleaching.
bioactivePayloadFormulations.coreComposition: Natural Astaxanthin (98% esterified extract, 3.5% w/v) in Supercritical CO2 with 3.5% v/v Ethanol Modifier
bioactivePayloadFormulations.bilayerLipidSystem: Hydrogenated Soy Phosphatidylcholine (HSPC, 85 mol%) + Cholesterol (15 mol%) Bilayer
bioactivePayloadFormulations.degradingAlternative: Ultrasonic Probe Sonication (>65°C hot spots, titanium tip erosion contamination, 38% astaxanthin oxidation)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.regulatoryStandard: FDA GRAS Notice GRN 000580, USP <729> Method I & EFSA Astaxanthin Safety Opinion

bioactivePayloadFormulations.name: Coenzyme Q10 (Ubiquinone) High-Bioavailability Nano-Liposomes
bioactivePayloadFormulations.payloadDescription: Hydrophobic ubiquinone encapsulated in high-fluidity unsaturated phospholipid bilayer stabilized by TPGS for cellular mitochondrial delivery.
bioactivePayloadFormulations.coreComposition: Coenzyme Q10 (99.5% purity, 4.0% w/v) in Supercritical CO2 with 4.0% v/v Ethanol Modifier
bioactivePayloadFormulations.bilayerLipidSystem: 1,2-Dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine (DOPC, 80 mol%) + D-α-Tocopheryl Polyethylene Glycol Succinate (TPGS, 20 mol%)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.degradingAlternative: High-Pressure Micro-Fluidization (1,500 bar shear stress causing quinone ring scission and erratic vesicle rupture)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.regulatoryStandard: USP Coenzyme Q10 Monograph, USP <729> & FDA 21 CFR § 101 Dietary Supplements

bioactivePayloadFormulations.name: Curcuminoid Polyphenol Ultra-Stable Nano-Liposomes (Curcuma longa)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.payloadDescription: Standardized curcuminoid triple complex encapsulated inside soy phosphatidylcholine nano-vesicles, boosting aqueous solubility by over 2,500-fold.
bioactivePayloadFormulations.coreComposition: Standardized Curcuminoids (95% purity: Curcumin, DMC, BDMC, 4.5% w/v) in Supercritical CO2 with 5.0% v/v Ethanol
bioactivePayloadFormulations.bilayerLipidSystem: Refined Soy Phosphatidylcholine (SPC-90, 82 mol%) + Glyceryl Distearate (18 mol%)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.degradingAlternative: Thin-Film Hydration / Rotary Evaporation (Entrapped chlorinated solvents, large multi-lamellar vesicles >450 nm, 8.5% entrapment)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.regulatoryStandard: USP Curcumin Monograph, USP <729> & FDA 21 CFR § 73.600

bioactivePayloadFormulations.name: Broad-Spectrum Cannabidiol (CBD) Water-Dispersible Nano-Liposomes
bioactivePayloadFormulations.payloadDescription: Non-psychotropic broad-spectrum phytocannabinoid isolate formulated into water-clear, surfactant-free unilamellar liposomes for rapid sublingual mucosal absorption.
bioactivePayloadFormulations.coreComposition: Natural Broad-Spectrum CBD (99.2% purity, 5.0% w/v) in Supercritical CO2 with 3.0% v/v Ethanol
bioactivePayloadFormulations.bilayerLipidSystem: Purified Egg Phosphatidylcholine (EPC-98, 88 mol%) + Sodium Cholate (12 mol%) Bilosome Complex
bioactivePayloadFormulations.degradingAlternative: High-Shear Rotor-Stator Mixing (Cannabinoid thermal oxidation, bitter degradation off-notes, phase separation within 72 h)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.regulatoryStandard: WHO ECDD Report, FDA cGMP 21 CFR § 111 & EFSA Novel Food Guidelines

bioactivePayloadFormulations.name: Synergistic Vitamin D3 + K2 (MK-7) Bone & Cardiovascular Nano-Liposomes
bioactivePayloadFormulations.payloadDescription: Fat-soluble vitamins D3 (cholecalciferol) and K2 (menaquinone-7) co-entrapped in rigid DPPC synthetic bilayer for targeted gastrointestinal release.
bioactivePayloadFormulations.coreComposition: Vitamin D3 (1.2% w/v) + Vitamin K2 (0.8% w/v) in Supercritical CO2 with 4.5% v/v Ethanol Modifier
bioactivePayloadFormulations.degradingAlternative: Ethanol Injection Method (Requires rotary solvent stripping, residual ethanol >5,000 ppm, unstable multi-lamellar structures)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.regulatoryStandard: USP Vitamin D3 / K2 Monographs, USP <729> & FDA 21 CFR § 101
